critical_code_review_comments: phase_ef_wave2.py at 586 lines is well under 700 — good modularization. All 8 endpoints in one file is acceptable since they share _llm_json helper.

_llm_json swallows all exceptions into {'_error': ...} — silently degrades to empty suggestions/advice instead of surfacing LLM/network issues to client. Consider logging via logger.warning so ops can see when EMERGENT_LLM_KEY is misconfigured.

price_tune/apply mutates products.price directly without snapshotting old price into a price_history collection — only lastPriceChange sub-doc stored. Recommend appending to a price_history array for audit (current schema overwrites previous AI change).

voice_to_recipe inserts to db.recipes even when LLM returns partial/empty structure — at minimum validate that 'name' and 'ingredients' fields are present before persisting, otherwise garbage rows accumulate.
labor_forecast peakHour = max(...,'total') ignores ties; harmless but could return earliest tie-breaker. Not blocking.
surge/apply does delete_many({}) then bulk insert — not atomic; if insert fails after delete, rules are wiped. Wrap in a transaction or use replace-style upsert.
overbooking_check uses fixed 1.1 buffer ratio hard-coded; surface as a settings document so owner can tune without code change.
